text: Harbour guns, Sergeant Kettle. You here to help or to gawk?
Mind the powder, {player}. It minds you back.
Every ship that gets into this harbour is a ship I didn't sink. I don't like those ships.
Can't see a sail in this. That's exactly when they'll come.
Listen to that thunder. Nobody sane is at sea tonight.
Storm's right on top of us. Stay in the dry a while.
Every timber in the harbour's groaning. Ugly night.
Wretched rain. Gets into everything.
Rain again. Good for the cisterns, bad for the soul.
You're dripping on my floor, by the way.
Late to be wandering about.
Night's when the cursed come walking. Keep a lantern lit.
Can't sleep either, eh?
Up with the gulls, I see.
Early start, {player}.
Mist'll burn off by mid-morning.
Happy {festival}, {player}! Everyone's in good spirits.
It's the {festival}. Half the town's drunk and the other half's working on it.
Ships come straight for the docks, eight waves of them. I'll lend you a cannon and shot.
Sink them before they get within the harbour mouth. Five get through and the town's lost. More hands on the guns, more chance we have.
Saturday nights, eight bells. The cursed fleet picks a port and comes ashore in force. Never the same port twice running.
Type /siege and the harbour office will tell you where they're expected. Bring friends. Bring more friends than that.
To your gun! Here they come!
